answer: My answer to sybils is Vetted hotelier licence with hoteliers association attestation — a licence the association renews after hotel inspections — which makes the gale of cheating a bill the attacker pays again for every clone. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own a licence the association renews after hotel inspections, and the willow grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the spiral of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
